title: APS 2026 Annual Progress Report for Planning Coordination
publisher: Arizona Public Service Company (to WECC Studies Subcommittee)
summary: APS's 2026 report to WECC (2026-2035). Requests Significant Impact waivers for three new projects: Morgan-Outer Circle 230kV (2030), Panda-Freedom 230kV #1 Upgrade (2031), Desert Sun 230/500kV Interconnections (2031); lists 26 previously waived projects with current in-service dates under the new names (Diamond, Helios, Wafer, Independence), consistent with the 2026 ten-year plan - a quick cross-check of what is in WECC base cases.

findings.statement: New waiver requests: Morgan-Outer Circle 230kV (~20 mi, 2030); Panda-Freedom 230kV #1 Upgrade (2031); Desert Sun 230kV and 500kV Interconnections (230kV energized 2030, 500kV 2031).

Previously waived project dates: Goodyear, Parkway, Broadway, Dromedary, Ironwood, West Camp 2025; Contrail and Hashknife 2026; Diamond, Sun Valley-Outer Circle, Helios-Milligan, Snowflake TPIF 2027; Bagdad, Bianco, Wafer, Q264 TPIF 2028; Cholla-Chevelon cut-in, North Gila-Orchard #2 2029; Pinnacle Peak-Ocotillo, Panda-Freedom #2, Runway-Stratus cut-in to TS21, Independence-Broadway, Agua Fria-Contrail, Saguaro Campus 2030; Jojoba-Rudd 2031; Four Corners-Cholla-Pinnacle Peak 345kV rebuilds 2038.
